quizzes.title: Business Administration for Sole Traders — Knowledge Check

questions.questionText: When must an Australian sole trader register for GST?
options: Immediately when they get an ABN
Once GST turnover reaches the current threshold ($75,000 at time of writing) — optional below it

questions.questionText: How long must you keep business records for the ATO?
The safest way to handle money for tax and GST is to:
options: Leave it all in one account and hope
Move a set percentage of every payment into a separate account as it arrives

questions.questionText: As a sole trader working in customers’ homes, the insurance you should never operate without is:
Under Australian WHS laws a sole trader is:
options: A PCBU with a duty to work safely, including for anyone who helps them
Only responsible if someone is injured
